heroHeadline: Taiwan Coast Guard Fires Water Cannons on Chinese Fishing Boats Near Disputed Dongsha Islands
heroSubtitle: President Trump stated on September 27, 2026 that Xi Jinping 'understands' his position on Taiwan — an ambiguous formulation that stops short of any specific commitment but confirms Taiwan was directly addressed at the Washington summit. Taiwan's Deputy Foreign Minister Francois Wu had already warned on September 26 that US arms sales and Taiwan's semiconductor role 'are important US interests,' pushing back against the summit's lack of clarity on the paused $14 billion arms package. PLA sorties dropped to 2 on September 25 as Xi departed, down from 10 on September 23-24.
